title: Part sales Delete lets the user delete part sales and reverse part sales invoices
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Parts Department ON, See Financial Data ON and Part sales View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open a part sale, then delete it.
  2. Open a part sales invoice and reverse it.
custom_expected:
The part sale is deleted.

The part sales invoice is reversed.

Reversing a part sales invoice is controlled by Part sales Delete, not by Invoicing & payments Delete.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: Part sales Delete affordance (delete/reverse a part sale) not located in this pass — the part-sale row menu did not open in the harness; needs the part-sale detail-page delete control with a with/without partSalesDelete contrast.
